name: exact_pipeline_stage_where_customers_drop_off
description: The exact pipeline stage deals were sitting in when they stopped progressing — marked lost or abandoned — with how many, the lost/abandoned split, and each stage's share of all deals that closed without a win. Use for 'where do customers drop off', 'which stage do we lose deals at', 'what stage do deals die at'. Also answers 'lost vs abandoned by stage': abandoned means dropped, lost means pursued and beaten, and pct_abandoned gives the split per stage. Covers this sub-account only. This is the stage a deal was IN when it closed. For where a deal spent the most TIME before closing — often a different stage — use the stage_deals_sit_in_longest_before_lost skill instead.

params.name: stage
params.description: Narrow to one stage by name, e.g. 'qualified'. Omit to see every stage.

params.name: min_deals
params.description: Only stages where at least this many deals closed without a win. Useful for ignoring one-off stages.
